description: This file defines the MembershipDao class responsible for data access operations related to Membership entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, listing, counting, and deleting Membership records, as well as checking for existing membership names.

classes.name: MembershipDao
classes.description: Data access object for Membership entity, providing database operations such as save, retrieve, delete, and list memberships.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Persists a Membership entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a Membership entity by its ID; returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingMembershipIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of existing membership IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Fetches a Membership by its name, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Returns a list of memberships based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getMembershipListPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator object for listing memberships with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Counts the number of memberships matching the search criteria.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple memberships based on an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks if a membership name already exists in the database.
